title: Magnetic Building Blocks 200 pcs – Build Your Own 3D World
seo_title: Magnetic Building Blocks 200 pcs – Magnetic Cubes to Build With
seo_description: 200 magnetic cubes with block and grass designs. The magnets hold the build in place instead of it collapsing. Age-rated 3+.
descriptionHtml:
Regular blocks collapse just as the tower starts getting tall

The taller the build gets, the easier it is to knock – one fingertip too many and everything falls. What's left is a pile of loose blocks and a child who has to start over from the beginning.

200 magnetic cubes that stay where you put them

The cubes have built-in magnets and a block print on the sides, so they attach to each other instead of just resting on each other. 200 cubes in the box is enough for much bigger builds than a regular bag of blocks. Age-rated 3+.

Features

  • 200 cubes in the box – enough for big builds without running out halfway.
  • The magnets hold the cubes in place – the build stays put instead of collapsing at the slightest nudge.
  • Block and grass designs on the cubes – they look like real building blocks, not plain plastic pieces.
  • Age-rated 3+ – suited for younger children, not just older siblings.

The lifestyle images are AI-generated illustrations.
